class.name: PDFTexture
class.brief_description: A texture imported from a single PDF page.
class.description: The Windows x64 editor can import a [code].pdf[/code] file as a [PDFTexture]. Select the page, DPI, rotation, background color, and common rendering options in the Import dock, then use the resource anywhere a [Texture2D] is accepted. The resource stores page metadata and the settings used to bake its pixels. Exported projects load the baked pixels without PDFium.

members.member: The background color used while rendering the imported page.
The resolution in dots per inch used to render the imported page.
If [code]true[/code], the source PDF page contains transparent content. This describes the PDF page and does not guarantee that the baked image has an alpha channel when an opaque background is used.
The imported page number, starting at 1.

The source page boxes keyed by [code]media[/code], [code]crop[/code], [code]bleed[/code], [code]trim[/code], and [code]art[/code], with [code]bounds[/code] when available. Present entries contain [Rect2] values in PDF points.
The total page count of the source PDF at import time.
The label assigned to this page by the source PDF, or an empty string if it has no label.
The source page's own rotation in degrees, before the additional [member rotation] is applied.
The source page size in PDF points, before the additional [member rotation] is applied. One PDF point is 1/72 of an inch.
The [PDFReader] render flags used to bake this page. The default includes [constant PDFReader.RENDER_ANNOTATIONS].
The additional rotation applied while rendering the page, in degrees. It is one of 0, 90, 180, or 270.
